map.管理蜂群摇蜜周期，追踪蜂箱位置与采蜜进度，自动计算下次摇蜜日期，记录每次摇蜜产量: Manage hive extraction cycles, track hive location and progress, auto-compute next extraction date, record each extraction yield. Data stored locally.
map.下次摇蜜日 = 上次取蜜日 + 流蜜周期(天)；周期按 7~14 天校验: Next extraction day = last extraction day + flow period (days); period validated 7-14 days
map.为每个蜂箱登记流蜜周期与起始日期，按「上次取蜜日 + 流蜜周期」递推下次摇蜜日并: Register each hive's flow period and start date; roll forward next extraction by "last + period", generating calendar and reminders, avoiding too-early extraction hurting capping or too-late honey crowding brood. Data in browser localStorage, pure front-end, no upload.
map.暂无蜂箱，请先添加: No hives yet, please add first
map.按月份显示主要蜜源流蜜情况（华东地区参考，实际因地域而异）: Show major nectar flows by month (East China reference; actual varies by region)
map.流蜜日历以华东地区为参考，实际蜜源花期因地域、海拔、气候而异，请结合当地情况调整: Nectar calendar is East China reference; actual bloom varies by region, altitude, climate; adjust locally
map.摇蜜周期建议在流蜜期为 7-14 天，非流蜜期不宜摇蜜，以免影响蜂群生存: Extraction period recommended 7-14 days in flow; avoid in non-flow to protect colony
map.每次摇蜜后请确保蜂箱内留足存蜜，至少保留 1-2 脾蜜供蜂群食用: After each extraction ensure enough honey left, at least 1-2 combs for the colony
map.「快速记录摇蜜」会以今天为日期记录产量，适合现场操作时使用: "Quick record extraction" uses today as date, good for field operation
map.数据保存在浏览器本地，清除缓存会丢失，建议定期导出备份: Data saved in browser local; clearing cache loses it; export backup periodically
map.按蜂箱登记流蜜周期（7~14 天）与起始日期，推算每个蜂箱的下次摇蜜（取蜜）日期: Register each hive's flow period (7-14 days) and start date to predict next extraction date.
map.多箱排期：汇总各箱摇蜜日生成日历，协调人手与摇蜜机，避免同一天多箱挤占。: Multi-hive scheduling: aggregate extraction days into a calendar, coordinate labor and extractor, avoid same-day crowding.
map.跟踪取蜜记录与产量，按箱统计累计取蜜量，评估蜜源期供给与蜂群产能。: Track extraction records and yield, cumulative by hive, assess flow supply and colony productivity.
map.5 月 20 日入场，流蜜周期设 10 天，则下次摇蜜为 5 月 30 日，依次: Entered May 20, flow period 10 days, next extraction May 30, then Jun 9, Jun 19. If capping insufficient, delay 2-3 days to avoid unripe honey fermenting.
map.流蜜周期设几天合适？: How many days for flow period?
map.以蜜源植物泌蜜节奏与封盖情况为准，常见 7~14 天。大流蜜期宜偏短（7~10: By nectar plant secretion rhythm and capping; common 7-14 days. Major flow prefer short (7-10), scattered sources longer; tool requires within 7-14.
map.各箱群势、王龄、入场时间不同，泌蜜与封盖进度并不一致。按箱排期可避免「一刀切」，: Each hive differs in strength, queen age, entry time; secretion and capping vary. Per-hive scheduling avoids "one-size-fits-all", reducing unripe-honey and brood-damage risk.
map.数据会保存到服务器吗？: Is data saved to a server?
map.蜂箱与取蜜记录存于浏览器本地存储（localStorage），不上传服务器；清除: Hive and extraction records in browser localStorage, no server upload; clearing browser data empties them. Periodically back up extraction records separately.
map.养蜂人的摇蜜周期管理工具。支持添加蜂箱并记录位置、流蜜周期和起始日期，内置 12: A beekeeper's extraction-cycle manager. Add hives and record location, flow period, start date; built-in 12-month nectar calendar; auto-compute per-hive next extraction date and countdown; record each extraction yield with monthly/hive stats, helping plan scientifically.
